gates.title: Every part of the BOM is in the product, as many as the BOM says
gates.detail: 25 parts from 12 of 14 BOM lines in one frame; not in it: res (on the LED's anode leads, under heat-shrink, wherever the leads end up); qtcable (a 100 mm flexible cable from the sensor's socket to the OLED's, routed by hand)

gates.title: No two parts are in the same place
gates.detail: 25 parts, no two share volume but the fits meant to (11)

gates.title: The parts meant to touch do
gates.detail: 42 parts touch the parts the design means them to

gates.title: Every other pair is at least 0.3 mm apart
gates.detail: every other pair is at least 0.3 mm apart; the closest within that reach are shell and usbcable, 0.44 mm

gates.title: The parts meant to be inside the case are inside it
It stands, tilted 10 deg and pushed
gates.detail: on the desk: 55.6 g, tips at 15.2 deg, a sideways pull of the USB cable at 0.58 N

gates.title: Sound gets out, ports and views are clear, light reaches its window, radios keep clear of metal
gates.detail: 5 probes pass: led, screen, screen-top-left, screen-bottom-right, co2-vents

pushes.name: a sideways pull of the USB cable

faults.fault: left out ins4, one of 4 on line ins
faults.detail: ins (Brass heat-set insert, M3 x 4 mm): 3 in the frame, the BOM has 4 per unit

faults.fault: moved pico to 0.25 mm from shell
lifted ins1 58.3 mm, out of its fit with shell
faults.detail: ins1 is meant to fit shell (each insert melted into its corner column's 4.0 mm hole) but shares no volume with it

faults.fault: lifted pico 51.0 mm, 2 mm clear of the case
faults.detail: pico reaches 23.05 mm outside the case shell/lid
ins1 should touch lid (each insert flush with the rim, under the lid) but is 0.50 mm away

faults.fault: slid lid 0.44 mm along shell, to 0.15 mm beside a contact
faults.detail: shell is 0.15 mm from lid beside where they touch, at (-22.1, 11.0, 53.7)

faults.fault: put 10 kg one product-width beyond the feet
faults.detail: on the desk: the centre of mass (117.4, 0.0) is outside what it stands on; on the desk: a sideways pull of the USB cable tips it at -345.66 N, under the 0.3 N it must stand

faults.fault: put 10 kg over the feet, 889 mm up
faults.detail: on the desk: tips at 0.6 deg, under 10

faults.fault: pushed it sideways at the top with 1000 N
faults.detail: on the desk: a planted 1000 N shove tips it at 0.23 N, under the 1000 N it must stand

faults.fault: put a plate in front of led
faults.detail: led: 0% of its light reaches out, under 95% (blocked by fault-plate-led)

faults.fault: put a plate in front of screen
faults.detail: screen: 0% of its light reaches out, under 95% (blocked by fault-plate-screen)

faults.fault: put a plate in front of screen-top-left
faults.detail: screen-top-left: 0% of its light reaches out, under 95% (blocked by fault-plate-screen-top-left)

faults.fault: put a plate in front of screen-bottom-right
faults.detail: screen-bottom-right: 0% of its light reaches out, under 95% (blocked by fault-plate-screen-bottom-right)
co2-vents: 0% of it sees out, under 40% (blocked by fault-lid-co2-vents)
